skill.name: flow-brainstorming
skill.description: Captures original requirements during flow initialization, explores alternatives, records decisions, and keeps later work aligned with BRAINSTORM.md.
skill.summary: Guides requirement brainstorming before implementation and records decisions for later alignment checks.
skill.author: Dimon94

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when vague requests become rushed implementation. This skill structures early brainstorming, compares options, and records decisions for later alignment.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the assistant to inspect project state, documents, and recent commits.
Presents two or three implementation approaches with tradeoffs.
Requires incremental validation of architecture, components, data flow, errors, and tests.
Defines required sections for a BRAINSTORM.md decision record.
Adds alignment checks for later flow stages.
limitations: Does not implement code or run tests by itself.
Assumes the surrounding DevFlow process and requirement IDs exist.
Relies on the assistant and user to keep BRAINSTORM.md accurate.
Uses prose instructions only; it does not provide executable automation.

use_cases.title: Clarify a New Feature
use_cases.description: Turn an initial product idea into purpose, constraints, success criteria, and candidate approaches.

use_cases.title: Compare Technical Paths
use_cases.description: Review multiple implementation strategies before choosing one and documenting the decision.

use_cases.title: Prevent Rushed Changes
use_cases.description: Slow down small fixes enough to capture the original need and avoid hidden assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Start Requirement Brainstorm
prompt_templates.prompt: Use flow-brainstorming for this request: {request}. Ask one clarifying question at a time before proposing a design.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Approaches
prompt_templates.prompt: Use flow-brainstorming to explore two or three approaches for {feature}. Include tradeoffs and recommend one option.

prompt_templates.title: Validate A Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use flow-brainstorming to present the proposed design for {request} in short sections. Ask for confirmation after each section.

prompt_templates.title: Create Alignment Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Use flow-brainstorming for REQ {id}: {title}. Capture original wording, success criteria, constraints, alternatives, decision, and alignment checks.

output_examples.input: A user asks to add a faster search page.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks targeted questions, defines success criteria, compares search strategies, and records the selected approach.

output_examples.input: A team wants to refactor authentication with unclear goals.
output_examples.output: The assistant separates security, maintainability, and user experience goals before recommending a refactor path.

output_examples.input: A later implementation step may diverge from the original plan.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks BRAINSTORM.md, identifies the divergence, and asks whether to update the documented decision.

best_practices: Ask one question per message until purpose, constraints, and success criteria are clear.
Record the user's original wording before summarizing or refining the request.
Recheck BRAINSTORM.md before later implementation phases.
anti_patterns: Skipping brainstorming because the request sounds small.
Choosing one design before comparing alternatives.
Writing a decision record without user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill implement the requested feature?
faq.answer: No. It guides requirement discovery and decision documentation before implementation starts.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands?
faq.answer: No. SKILL.md contains Markdown and YAML examples, not executable command logic.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for product planning?
faq.answer: No. It also supports engineering design, refactoring decisions, and workflow alignment checks.

faq.question: Can it replace user decisions?
faq.answer: No. It asks the user to confirm the final approach and any later divergence.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the request, known constraints, success criteria, and a requirement ID when using DevFlow.
